budget.budgetCaveat: Sleep bounds exclude fetch latency, redirects, middleware and RPC lifetime; caller timeout is not proof server retry work stopped.

conclusion.readonlyGET: Permit existing bounded proxy retry for allowlisted semantic read-only control-plane GETs with explicit request/overall budgets, fresh current deployment/latest/settings/configuration brackets, expiry checks, no use of late evidence, and original-scope identity. Do not add outer retry loops. Public source is a risk model, not deployed runtime attestation.
conclusion.writesAndBudgetConsumingActions: Hard block through this default retry proxy. Require independently established single-dispatch/no automatic replay at every layer before any PUT or paid experiment action. Idempotent method naming, rawBody, journal intent, app loop count and successful status do not establish no proxy replay.

caveats: No Request body clone per attempt: code-mode Request body reuse may fail on later attempts in some runtimes; this is not a reliable no-replay policy. Non-code-mode string/body init is independently retryable.
When a 429 was observed before later network failures, helper may return stale lastResponse 429. Never infer final applied/not-applied state from this.
Original bytes and authoritative entrypoint requirements remain; retry review does not accept MIME implementation.
